Source: Our novel method uses an ‘optimal weighting’ of estimates based on an implementation of a particular ‘synthetic cohort’ approach (interpreting the age/time structure of prevalence, in conjunction with estimates of excess mortality) and biomarkers of ‘recent infection’ (combining Lag-Avidity, Bio-Rad Avidity and viral load results to define recent infection, and adapting the method for age-specific incidence estimation).
Luganda: Akakodyo kaffe kano akapya kakozesa ‘enkola y’okutuukanya’ ebiteeberezo okusinziira ku kukozesa enkola ‘y’okulondoola obulamu’ bw’omuntu omulundi gumu (okutaputa emyaka/ekiseera n’obweyolesi ng’ogasseeko n’omuwendo omuteebereze ogw’abantu abafa obulwadde ekisusse mu kiseera eky’akatyabaga) n’obunonero ‘bw’obulwadde obusembyeyo’ okukwata omuntu (okugatta ebyava mu kukebera oba ng’omuntu yakwatibwako ku mukeenenya gye buvuddeko awamu n’obubaka obukwata ku bungi bwa mukeenenya mu kuzuula obulwadde omuntu bw’asembyeyo okufuna, awamu n’okutuukanya akakodyo okusobola okukozesebwa mu kuteebereza okukwatibwa kw’obulwadde mu bantu abali mu ttuluba ly’emyaka egimu).
Yoruba: Ònà ète ọ̀tu yí ń lo ‘optimal weighting’ ti gbèdéke ìṣirò tó dá lórí i ìṣàgbéjáde irúfẹ́ ìlàna synthetic cohort’ (ṣíṣètúmọ̀ ọjọ́ orí/àkókò ìtànká, ní ìbámu pẹ̀lú u gbèdéke ìṣirò ọ̀pọ ikú àwọn ènìyàn) àti biomarker ti ‘àkóràn àìpẹ́’ (ìdàpọ Lag-Avidity, Bio-Rad Avidity àti èti viral load láti wo ìkóràn àìsàn, àti ṣíṣàdàpè ìlànà ajemọ́j́ọ́orí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀).
Zulu: Indlela yethu entsha isebenzisa 'isisindo esifanele' sezilinganiso ezibhekiselwe ekusetshenzisweni kwendlela ethile kwenhlanganisela yeqoqo' (echaza iminyaka/isikhathi sokudlanga, ngokuhambisana nezilinganiso zokufa ngokweqile) kanye nezinkandasifo 'zokutheleleka kwakamuva' (kuhlanganisa I-Lag-Avidity, i-Bio-Rad Avidity kanye nemiphumela yenani yezinhlayiya ukuchaza ukutheleleka kwakamuva, kanye nokujwayela indlela yokulinganisa izehlakalo eziqondene neminyaka ethile).
Hausa: Sabuwar hanyarmu tana amfani da 'nauyi mafi dacewa' na ƙiyasi bisa aiwatar da takamaiman tsarin 'bincike kan mutum ɗaya' (fassarar tsarin shekaru/lokaci na yaɗuwa, tare da ƙiysata yawan mace-mace) da kuma siffofin gano cuta na 'cututtukan kwanan nan' (haɗa Lag-Avidity, Bio-Rad Avidity da sakamakon yawan ƙwayoyin cuta a mutum don ayyana kamuwa da cuta kwanan nan, da daidaita hanyar ƙiyasta ƙayyadaddun abubuwan da suka faru na shekaru).
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wa rena o moswa o šomiša ‘kelo ya boima bja godimo’ ya dikakanyo go lebeletšwe phethagatšo ya mokgwa wo o itšego wa ‘legoro la maikemišetšo’ (go hlatholla sebopego sa mengwaga/nako ya tiragalo, gammogo le dikakanyo tša mahu a go feta tekanyo) le dipayomakha tša ‘phetetšo ya bjale’ (go kopanya Lag-Avidity, Bio-Rad Avidity le dipoelo tša kelo ya bogolo bja dibaerase go hlaloša phetetšo ya bjale, le go šomiša mokgwa wa kakanyo ya malwetši a go amana le mengwaga).

Source: Using the combined method, we find that age-specific HIV incidence in females rose rapidly during adolescence, from 1.33 cases/100 person-years (95% CI: 0.98,1.67) at age 15 to a peak of 5.01/100PY (4.14,5.87) at age 23.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa enkola ey’obukodyo obubiri, tuzudde ng’okukwatibwa kwa HIV okwetooloolera ku myaka egimu mu bakyala kwalinnya nnyo mu kiseera ky’obuvubuka, okuva ku munttu 1.33/100 buli mwaka (95% CI: 0.98, 1.67) ku myaka 15 okutuuka ku ntikko ya bantu 5.01/100PY (4.14, 5.87) ku myaka 23.
Yoruba: Lílo ète méjéèjì yí, a ri pé ìṣẹ̀lẹ HIV tó jẹ mọ́ ọjọ́ orí nínú àwọn obìnrin gbèrú ní ìgbà ọ̀dọ́, láti 1.33 ìṣẹ̀lẹ/100 ẹni-ọdún (95% CI: 0.98,1.67) ní ọjọ́ orí 15 sí góńgó 5.01/100PY (4.14,5.87) ní ọjọ́ orí 23.
Zulu: Ngokusebenzisa indlela ehlanganisiwe, sithola ukuthi izehlakalo ze-HIV eziqondene neminyaka ethile kwabesifazane zikhuphuke ngokushesha phakathi nenkathi yemfufusa, kusukela kwizehlo ezi-1.33/100 umuntu-iminyaka (95% CI: 0.98,1.67) eneminyaka eyi-15 kuya ku-5.01/100PY (4.14, 5.87) eneminyaka engama-23.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da hanyar haɗin gwiwa, mun gano cewa yawan kamuwa da cutar HIV ta musamman a cikin mata ya tashi da sauri a lokacin samartaka, daga lokuta 1.33 yawan kamuwa/mutane 100 a shekara (95% CI: 0.98,1.67) a shekaru 15 zuwa ƙololuwar 5.01/100PY (4.14, 5.87) a shekaru 23.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša mokgwa wa mohlakanelwa, re hwetša gore malwetši a HIV a go amana le mengwaga go basadi a hlatlogile kudu ge ba le mahlalagading, go tloga go malwetši a 1.33/go batho ba 100-mengwaga (95% CI: 0.98,1.67) go mengwaga ye 15 go fihla sehloeng sa 5.01/100PY (4.14,5.87) go mengwaga ye 23.

Source: In males, incidence was lower, 0.34/100PY (0.00-0.74) at age 15, and rose later, peaking at 3.86/100PY (2.52-5.20) at age 30.

Source: Susceptible population-weighted average incidence in females aged 15-29 was estimated at 3.84/100PY (3.36-4.40), in males aged 15-29 at 1.28/100PY (0.68-1.50) and in all individuals aged 15-29 at 2.55/100PY (2.09-2.76).

Yoruba: Àwọn akópa ìwádìí ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ nínú àwọn obìnrin tí ọjọ́ orí wọ́n tó 15 - 29 ní gbèdéke ìṣirò 3.84/100PY (3.36-4.40), nínú àwọn ọkùnrin tí ọjọ́ orí wọ́n tó 15 - 29 ni 1.28/100PY (0.68-1.50) àti nínú gbogbo ènìyàn tí ọjọ́ orí wọ́n tó 15 -29 ní 2.55/100PY (2.09-2.76).
Zulu: Izehlakalo ezithintekayo ezinesisindo sabantu besifazane abaneminyaka engu-15-29 zilinganiselwa ku-3.84/100PY (3.36-4.40), kwabesilisa abaneminyaka engu-15-29 ku-1.28/100PY (0.68-1.50) futhi kubo bonke abantu abaneminyaka engu-15-29 ubudala I-2.55/100PY (2.09-2.76).
